description: This file defines the ShapeHolder class, which encapsulates a ShapeDrawable along with properties such as position, color, gradient, alpha transparency, and dimensions, used for drawing shapes in Android graphics.

classes.name: ShapeHolder
classes.description: A data class that holds a ShapeDrawable and its properties such as position, color, gradient, alpha transparency, and size for use in Android graphics.

methods.name: setPaint
methods.description: Sets the Paint object used for drawing the shape.

methods.name: getPaint
methods.description: Returns the Paint object associated with the shape.

methods.name: setX
methods.description: Sets the X coordinate position of the ShapeHolder.

methods.name: setShape
methods.description: Assigns a ShapeDrawable to the ShapeHolder.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns the ShapeDrawable associated with the ShapeHolder.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the current color of the shape.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the shape and updates the Paint object.

methods.name: setGradient
methods.description: Assigns a RadialGradient to the ShapeHolder.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the transparency level of the shape, adjusting the alpha value accordingly.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the shape.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the shape.

methods.name: ShapeHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ShapeHolder with a given ShapeDrawable.
